svg.title: urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer
svg.desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit. Steps: 1 · urna tui: the explorer / 2 · open: 1 opens the quickstart.urna found in the folder / 3 · ask: text in, cited answer out / 4 · each hit: the exact rerank score, the stored text, the citation / 5 · health: the doctor, live / 6 · quit: ctrl+q, from any tab
